package main

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestS279ScratchOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	args, owner := borrowCallArgs(2)
	if owner == nil {
		t.Fatal("small call did not borrow scratch")
	}
	args[0] = reflect.ValueOf(new(int))
	other, second := borrowCallArgs(1)
	if owner == second {
		t.Fatal("active calls share scratch")
	}
	other[0] = reflect.ValueOf("another call")
	releaseCallArgs(owner)
	for _, v := range owner.values {
		if v.IsValid() {
			t.Fatal("returned scratch retained a value")
		}
	}
	if other[0].String() != "another call" {
		t.Fatal("release changed another call")
	}
	releaseCallArgs(second)
	for _, n := range []int{0, callArgsScratchLimit + 1, 4096} {
		args, owner := borrowCallArgs(n)
		if len(args) != n || owner != nil {
			t.Fatalf("size %d: len=%d pooled=%v", n, len(args), owner != nil)
		}
		releaseCallArgs(owner)
	}
}
